insurer_name: HDFC ERGO General Insurance Company Limited
sub_limits_waiting_notes: Designed specifically for individuals with Type 1 / Type 2 Diabetes, IFG, IGT, and/or Hypertension. Diabetes and hypertension covered from Day 1 once policy issued. Wellness Programme included.

inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Includes room, ICU, OT, anaesthesia, blood, oxygen, surgical appliances, drugs, diagnostics, implants.

ayush_coverage.notes: Inpatient AYUSH treatment in certified AYUSH hospital.

organ_donor_expenses.notes: Donor hospitalisation expenses for transplant to insured.

restoration_benefit.notes: Restore benefit refills SI after exhaustion.

preventive_health_checkup.notes: HbA1C checkup benefit + structured Wellness Programme for Diabetes and Hypertension.

notable_exclusions_summary: Disease-specific (diabetes/hypertension) indemnity plan. Diabetes/HTN covered from Day 1 once underwritten. Other PED waiting 36 months. Standard health exclusions apply.
